properties.discussion:
A trough of low pressure located several hundred miles northeast of  Bermuda is producing disorganized showers and thunderstorms. Recent  scatterometer wind data indicate that the circulation remains  elongated and broad. Environmental conditions are becoming  increasingly hostile, and development is no longer expected.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...near 0 percent.

An area of low pressure associated with a tropical wave, located a  few hundred miles south-southwest of the Cabo Verde Islands, is  producing showers and thunderstorms that are displaced to the  southwest of its center. Environmental conditions remain somewhat  favorable for development over the next couple of days, and a  tropical depression is likely to form over the next day or two as  the system moves westward to west-northwestward across the eastern  and central tropical Atlantic. Environmental conditions are forecast  to become less favorable by this weekend, potentially ending its  chances for development.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

Shower and thunderstorm activity has increased since yesterday in  association with a tropical wave located well to the south of  southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions are expected to  support gradual development of this system, and a tropical  depression is likely to form during the next couple of days while it  moves west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, well offshore of Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form this weekend well to the south  of southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions appear favorable  for some gradual development of this system, and a tropical  depression could form by early next week while it moves westward to  west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...50 percent.

A weak, elongated area of low pressure located well to the  east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands is producing disorganized  showers and thunderstorms. Environmental conditions appear conducive  for gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression is  likely to form late this week or early this weekend while the system  drifts to the northeast, then turns westward. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south of the Hawaiian  Islands late this week or over the weekend. Some gradual development  is possible by early next week while the system moves slowly  west-northwestward, well south-southwest of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
